comparative_baseline_observation: Across the batch, Anchor A4 exhibits the cleanest and most uniform contact bands at the magenta line on both sides, showing minimal surface irregularities. In contrast, Anchor A3 displays significant structural discontinuities, particularly on the right side, which include raised ridges and potential mortar crusts intersecting the magenta line. Anchors A1, A2, and A5 show varying degrees of minor imperfections but are generally less obstructed than A3.
